---
title: "simstim host alerts"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Show where a host sends alerts about its sessions, and the last deliveries.

```text
simstim host alerts <host> [flags]
```

A host can tell you when a session needs you, finishes a long turn or fails, with the laptop shut. It sends events to destinations you name: an ntfy topic, a webhook or a command on the host. Nothing is sent until you name one. See docs/how-to/alerts.md.

## Examples

```sh
simstim host alerts my-vps
simstim host alerts set my-vps --ntfy https://ntfy.sh/<your-topic>
simstim host alerts test my-vps
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | print JSON |

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`host alerts log`](host_alerts_log.md) | Show the host's last alert deliveries, and why any were not sent |
| [`host alerts off`](host_alerts_off.md) | Turn alerts off on a host: remove its alerts file |
| [`host alerts set`](host_alerts_set.md) | Choose where a host sends alerts, and which ones |
| [`host alerts test`](host_alerts_test.md) | Send a test alert to every destination now, and say what each did |

Part of [`host`](host.md): add, create, list, test and remove hosts.
